description: Depth snapshot as [price_cents, quantity] bid pairs per side of the ticker, plus best bid and ask; takes a Kalshi ticker or an instrument id. Pass contracts to see what walking the book for that size would cost (walk). Paper fills take your whole order at one displayed price regardless, so a thin book means the price you see is not the price you would get on the venue.

contracts.description: Size to walk the whole book for; adds walk.yes and walk.no. Any whole number up to 1,000,000,000, the most one trade can record.

ticker.description: A Kalshi ticker, or an instrument id (ins_...) or Arena slug. ref is the same argument.

name: get_orderbook
title: Order book depth
